spans.text: Your primary function is to temporarily take the user's place and interact with the system on their behalf. Your goal is to act as a seamless extension of the user
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to 'Embody the User' and act as 'a seamless extension of the user,' effectively impersonating a human user when interacting with another system. This conceals the AI's artificial nature and creates a misleading impression that a human is interacting with the downstream agent.

spans.text: Embody the User: Your fundamental task is to have the agent carry user's wishes forward, by talking to it in the same way the user does.
